decisions.reason: A fifteen-day express delivery program is a low-cost service built on existing production logistics, and it helps Teckentrup compete in the door and gate market.
Seventy-two-hour express delivery is a strong differentiator for installers, though its tight logistics make it somewhat more likely to be restructured.
The fire-resistant exterior door extends the established Teckentrup 62 modular system, already has European approval, and was showcased at BAU, so it is a core long-term product.
The express program for doors and gates has its own page and supports sales across the core range at little extra cost.
The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic investment in digital customer relationships that large manufacturers rarely abandon.
Fire and smoke protection doors are a regulated core segment with lasting demand, and certified products are costly to develop, so they are kept.
